predictions.selection_reason: Config.highlight value -> || true bug -> always forces highlight true regardless of user setting
predictions.source_summary: Configuration values loaded from meta.settings.get('markdown') with defaults including 'highlight': true. Boolean fields are converted from 'on'/'off' strings to true/false values.
predictions.sink_summary: The highlight setting controls client-side syntax highlighting via hljs.highlightBlock() and is exposed via /markdown/config API endpoint. When true, it enables client-side code execution for syntax highlighting.
predictions.guard_summary: No validation guards on the configuration processing logic. The bug bypasses user configuration by always defaulting to true when config.highlight is falsy.
predictions.risk_pattern: Configuration processing bug forces highlight=true regardless of user setting due to incorrect logical OR operator usage, enabling client-side code execution features that users may have disabled.
predictions.context_summary: The bug occurs during markdown plugin initialization where configuration is loaded. The statement incorrectly uses || true which always evaluates to true, overriding any false user setting for highlight functionality.
